title: Classic Polynomial Times Exponential Integration by Parts
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar

steps.title: Choose u and dv
steps.mathExpression: u = x \implies du = dx; \quad dv = e^{2x} dx \implies v = \frac{1}{2} e^{2x}
steps.explanation: Apply LIATE rule: algebraic u = x, exponential dv = e^(2x) dx.

steps.title: Apply Integration by Parts Formula
steps.mathExpression: \int u \, dv = uv - \int v \, du = \frac{x}{2} e^{2x} - \frac{1}{2} \int e^{2x} dx

steps.title: Integrate Remaining Term and Factor
steps.explanation: Integrate e^(2x) and factor out e^(2x)/4.
